root_cause: The original public source worker records SOURCE_HTML_UNAVAILABLE and a constant 4h retry even when a source has failed five times; it discards upstream fetch status and redirect/TLS/timeout reasons so existing agents cannot choose an evidence-based next repair. Actual upstream reason remains UNKNOWN until first subsequent diagnostics run.
corrective_action: Store URL-free/person-free bounded fetch failure codes and deterministic 4/12/24/48 hour due retry directly on same original action. After >=5 failures assign existing source owner alternate lawful first-party source or next safe due retry. Never convert failure into verified address, consent, provider send or consumer ACK.
prevention_rule: Classify any SOURCE_HTML_UNAVAILABLE after bounded HTTPS same-host fetch, preserve original source evidence/action, fail closed on missing body, host redirect or timeout. Reduce repeated retries; keep other company domain rotation active. Only natural original executor acts.
